help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Everything you need to know to get started and make the most of WineExporters.

steps.title: Create your domain profile
steps.description: Fill in your domain name, location, certifications, and a description of your wine style. A complete profile improves campaign relevance.

steps.title: Add your wines
steps.description: From the Profile page, add each wine with its color, appellation, EXW price, and vintages. This information helps target the right buyers.

steps.title: Launch your first campaign
steps.description: Choose your target markets, write your message or let us help you, then submit your campaign. Our team validates it within 24–48h before sending.

steps.title: Track your prospects
steps.description: Interested importers appear in your CRM. Manage them in list or Kanban view, add notes, and track each opportunity's progress.

qa.q: How do I properly fill in my domain profile?
qa.a: Fill in all fields: domain name, location, certifications (organic, biodynamic…), description of your wines and current markets. A complete profile increases targeting quality. Don't forget to add at least one wine.
Add the wines you want to export. For each, specify color, appellation, EXW price in euros, available vintages, and whether it is organic/natural. This information helps target matching importers.
Certifications (AB, Demeter, Nature & Progrès…) are important search criteria for many importers, especially in Northern Europe and North America. Filling them improves targeting precision.

qa.q: Can I edit my profile after launching a campaign?
qa.a: Yes, you can edit your profile anytime. Information is used at campaign creation; edits do not affect campaigns already sent.

You define your target markets, choose wines to highlight, write a personalized message, and submit the campaign. Our team validates the content then sends the email to a selection of qualified importers in your markets.
Our team reviews each campaign within 24–48 business hours. You receive a notification as soon as the campaign is validated and ready to go.
Importers who respond positively (price requests, samples, meetings…) automatically appear in your CRM as prospects. You can then contact them directly.

qa.q: Can I cancel a campaign after submission?
qa.a: You can contact our support before validation to cancel or modify a campaign. Once validated and launched, sending can no longer be cancelled.

qa.q: How do prospects appear in my CRM?
qa.a: When an importer responds positively to your campaign, they are automatically added to your CRM with available information (country, company, requested action). You'll find all your prospects in the CRM List and CRM Kanban pages.

qa.q: How to manage the sales pipeline?
qa.a: The Kanban view lets you drag prospects from one column to another based on progress: New → Samples requested → Tasting → Negotiation → Won / Lost. Add notes to each prospect to track exchanges.

qa.q: Can I add a prospect manually?
qa.a: This feature is under development. For now, prospects are created automatically from campaign responses.

qa.q: What's the difference between Free and Premium?
qa.a: The Free plan lets you create your profile and explore the platform. Premium includes 1 prospecting campaign per month, full CRM access, and priority validation.

qa.q: How do I upgrade to Premium?
qa.a: Go to the Billing section in the sidebar. You can subscribe to the monthly plan in a few clicks via our secure Stripe payment system.
No, campaign credits are monthly and do not stack. We recommend using your campaign every month to maximize prospecting.

method.title: Our 3-step method to grow your markets.

step1.title: Stop searching for buyers. Find them.
step1.text: Access a global, qualified database of importers and distributors.
step1.bullet1: Precise filtering by market and buyer type.
step1.bullet2: Bespoke search: Targeting a specific market? Use your monthly credit. Our experts analyze your winery and wines to deliver a relevant selection of importers.

step2.title: Campaigns that finally generate replies.
step2.text: No more blind outreach. We help you capture decision-makers' attention with a targeted approach.
step2.bullet2: Managed monthly campaign: You validate, we send. We optimize deliverability so your message lands in the inbox, not in spam.

step3.title: Turn prospects into customers.
step3.text: An importer asks for your prices? Never let an opportunity slip away.
step3.bullet1: Visual pipeline (Kanban CRM) dedicated to wine export sales.
step3.bullet3: Centralized history so you never forget a follow-up.

synthesis.title: One platform. Zero friction. With real humans.
synthesis.text:
Our platform replaces your Excel files, complex emailing tools, and Google searches.

More importantly, it's not just software: behind every bespoke search and prospecting campaign, our team of experts is working to sell your wines.
